battle.name: 侯景之亂
battle.brief: 太清二年十月侯景於寒山舉兵反梁，三年正月渡江采石直趨建康。羊侃固守臺城，侯景環築壘圍城，以發石車與撞車進攻，近一年始入，逼蕭衍禪位而自立為漢帝。承聖元年蕭詧遣王僧辯、陳霸先討之，侯景兵敗病歿舟中，亂事始平。卡面投石機即此役攻城器械的代表。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 侯景之亂的交戰方，表面上是一方北齊邊軍、一方梁朝，實際上經過三次易手。第一階段是北齊內部的叛亂：侯景原為高歡部將，鎮守河南，領河南行台兵權，兵眾以北鎮降人與州郡部曲為主，騎兵與步卒分屯州縣，器械則多承東魏舊有的弩機、拒馬槍與守城之具，北齊朝廷以樞密院調度諸軍，遣慕容紹宗等率騎追討而不能得手。第二階段是侯景與梁朝的正面對抗：侯景以河南行台的名義向梁索糧借兵，渡淮後在采石、姑孰一線與梁軍爭奪渡口，梁朝以揚州、豫州、司州各鎮兵分守，蕭衍以中樞調兵，並以羊侃鎮守臺城。第三階段是侯景自立之後與梁朝荊州方面的對抗：蕭詧據江陵，領荊、雍二州兵，以王僧辯、陳霸先為主將自西向東討伐，形成以建康臺城為中心的東西對攻。整場戰爭的兵力結構，是北方騎兵與南方步卒加上攻城器械的組合，而投石機這類器械正落在侯景軍的攻城隊列與梁軍城防工事的交界處。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in Hou Jing's rebellion began as a clash between a Northern Qi frontier army and the Liang court, but the war changed hands three times. In the first phase it was a mutiny inside Northern Qi: Hou Jing had been a general under Gao Huan, holding the office of Henan Grand Director with authority over a large body of troops drawn from surrendered northern men and local household contingents, with cavalry and infantry garrisoned across the commanderies and the older Eastern Wei stock of crossbow engines, caltrops and wall gear inherited unchanged. The Qi court moved its forces through the Bureau of Military Affairs and sent Mengchong Shaozong and others after him without success. The second phase was open war between Hou Jing and Liang: he claimed the standing of a Henan Grand Director to beg Liang for grain and troops, then, after crossing the Huai, fought for the crossings at Caishi and Gushu against Liang forces from the Yang, Yu and Si prefectures, with Emperor Xiao Yan directing the dispatch of troops from the central secretariat and Yang Kan holding the palace city. The third phase was a civil war between Hou Jing's self-declared Han and the Jingzhou commanderies of Xiao Chen, who mustered the armies of Jing and Yong under Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian to attack eastwards, creating an east-west pincer centred on the palace city of Jiankang. The force structure throughout was northern cavalry combined with southern infantry and siege engineering, and the traction stone-thrower stood exactly at the seam between Hou Jing's attacking tools and Liang's defensive works.
people: 侯景，懷州人，出身行伍，先隸爾朱榮，後歸高歡，尚高歡女兒，位至河南行台，權傾一州。他起兵時已年五十餘，於寒山聚眾數千，因糧食不給而連夜南行，渡淮後用舟艦載兵械順流而下，兵眾號稱十餘萬，進逼建康時稱帝的打算已經成形。梁武帝蕭衍是這場亂局的核心人物，他兩度調兵增援，把朝廷存亡押在蕭綸與羊侃身上。羊侃是揚州刺史，出身軍門，善使槊，據臺城以地道、層壘與城樓應對侯景的攻城器械，卻在圍城半年之後病逝，臺城人心隨即崩解。蕭綸自采石一線率援軍北上，兵多而後援不繼，在寒山一戰被侯景擊潰。侯景入臺城後以王偉為謀主，逼迫蕭衍禪位給蕭綱，繼而廢蕭綱、立蕭棟，最後自立為漢帝。荊州方面的蕭詧、王僧辯、陳霸先在侯景疲敝之後接手戰局：陳霸先以精騎夜襲渇浦，斷其歸路，侯景退守建康一線，兵心盡散。
peopleEn: Hou Jing was a native of Huai prefecture who had risen from the ranks. He first served under Erzhu Rong, then attached himself to Gao Huan and married one of Gao Huan's daughters, rising to the office of Henan Grand Director with the military authority of an entire province. He was already past fifty when he raised his revolt, gathering only a few thousand men at Hanshan and then marching south by night because he had no grain; once across the Huai he carried his men and his war machines down the river in boat flotillas, his host numbered at over a hundred thousand, and by the time he stood before Jiankang he was already set on claiming the imperial title. Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, was the central figure of the catastrophe: he called up reinforcements twice and staked the survival of the court on Xiao Lun and Yang Kan. Yang Kan, governor of Yang prefecture, came of a military family and was famed for the long spear; he held the palace city with tunnels, layered barricades and tower platforms against Hou Jing's siege train, but died of illness half a year into the siege and the defenders' morale collapsed with him. Xiao Lun led the relief army north from the Caishi line, numerous but without follow-up support, and was beaten by Hou Jing at Hanshan. Once inside the palace city, Hou Jing took Wang Wei as his chief adviser, forced Xiao Yan to abdicate in favour of Xiao Gang, then deposed Xiao Gang, enthroned Xiao Dong, and finally proclaimed himself emperor of Han. On the Jingzhou side, Xiao Chen, Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian took over the war once Hou Jing had exhausted himself: Chen Baxian struck at Gupu by night with a picked cavalry force, cut off Hou Jing's line of retreat, and drove him back to guard Jiankang with his army's nerve completely broken.
kits: 卡面的投石機(Onager)是羅馬式的扭力擲石機，靠絞盤蓄能、拋桿釋放，射程遠而單發石重。它的亞洲對應物是弩機砲一類的發石機：戰國以降各國已用弩力發石，漢代記載的飛石與魏晉的發石車屬於同一技術路線的不同說法；南朝梁的軍械中既有承自北朝的舊式發石機，也有改用槓桿、絞索與配重的投石車，兩者在原理上都屬卡面這種把蓄能轉成一次投射的機器。侯景之亂把這類器械推到極限：其軍隊渡淮後即以舟艦運載攻城器材，圍臺城時以發石車壓制城頭、以撞車撞擊城門、以鉤車鉤挑城上守卒，配以火箭、橹車與臨時築起的木壘、土山，把臺城西面與南面封成一片攻城陣地，器械隊與突擊隊分列左右，輪流掩護進逼。守方並非全無對手：羊侃在城內築樓、掘地道通到城外反擊，又備擂石、撞杆與大量弓弩，弩機發矢的射速遠高於石砲。梁軍另以蹶張弓與床弩壓制城下操作器械的人手。就器械而言，這是南朝數百年間記載最完整的一次攻城戰。
kitsEn: The onager on the card is a Roman traction stone-thrower: a winch stores the energy, a throwing arm releases it, giving long range and a heavy single stone. Its Asian counterpart is the crossbow-powered stone catapult, the fāshí machine of the Han and the fāshí chē of Wei and Jin; the arsenal of the Liang court held older northern-style engines alongside improved traction throws using levers, twisted rope and counterweights, and in principle both belong to the same family as the card's machine, which turns stored energy into a single heavy projectile. Hou Jing's rebellion pushed such equipment to its limit: once across the Huai his army carried siege material downriver in boats, and around the palace city he used stone-throwing engines to suppress the parapets, battering rams against the gates and hooked poles to pull down defenders posted on the walls, backed up by fire arrows, hide-covered carts and hastily raised timber barricades and earthen mounds, sealing the western and southern approaches into one continuous attacking position, with engine crews and storming parties drawn up side by side and taking turns. The defenders were not without answers either: Yang Kan built towers inside the walls, dug tunnels that emerged outside the city to strike the besiegers, and stocked the ramparts with dropped stones, pole rams and a large number of bows and crossbows, whose bolts flew far faster than stones. Liang troops also used strong recurved bows and bed crossbows to pin down the crews working the siege machines at the foot of the wall. In terms of equipment, this is the most completely recorded siege of the Southern dynasties.
tactics: 侯景這一套打法，貴在三段銜接。先是起兵奇襲：寒山起事時只帶數千兵與不足的糧食，靠的是北齊內部的裂縫與北方部眾的快速集結，兵鋒直指河南與淮南，不給北齊以整頓的時間。再是趁風渡江，舟艦夜發，避開梁軍在采石、姑孰一線的正面阻擊，落地即攻，不讓對手重新布防。最後是長久圍城，環築營壘，把石砲、撞車、火箭與工程兵分作數隊，輪番上列，白晝不絕地敲擊城頭，並在營旁築山築壘逼近，逼迫守軍不得不在缺糧與疲憊中輪流休息，最後才調集兵力硬撞城門。守方羊侃的戰術完全相反：深溝高壘、死守不出，卻不斷以地道反擊與樓上射擊消耗進攻方，箭石交下，使侯景的器械隊與突擊隊難以同時展開。蕭綸的援軍則犯了最典型的毛病，兵多而進退無據，目標又分散在江寧寒山一線，結果被侯景集中兵力反覆打散。戰局最後的翻轉在荊州方面：陳霸先不與侯景爭城，只帶精騎夜襲渇浦，把侯景的後路與糧道一起切斷；侯景退回建康一線之後，再也組織不出一次成形的反擊。
tacticsEn: Hou Jing's method had three stages joined seamlessly. First, the surprise rising: at Hanshan he had only a few thousand men and not enough grain, and relied on the fissures inside Northern Qi and the speed with which northern followers rallied to his banner, driving straight for Henan and the Huai so that the Qi court had no time to reorganise. Second, the crossing: his boat flotillas put out on a favourable wind and travelled by night, avoiding the frontal blocking forces Liang had posted along the Caishi and Gushu lines, and he attacked as soon as he landed rather than allowing the enemy to reset his line. Third, the long siege: he ringed the city with entrenchments, split his stone-throwers, rams, fire-arrow crews and engineers into separate units that took turns at the front, hammering the parapets day and night and raising mounds and works beside his camp to close the distance, so that the defenders had to rest in turn while hungry and exhausted, until he could at last bring his strength together against the gates. Yang Kan's method was the exact opposite: deep ditches, high works, no sorties, but constant counterattack through tunnels and shooting from the towers to grind down the attackers, with arrows and stones falling on the engines and the storming parties so that the two could never deploy at once. Xiao Lun's relief force made the classic mistake: many troops but no line of retreat, its objectives scattered along the Hanshan and Jiangning line, so Hou Jing concentrated his strength and broke it again and again. The final turn came from Jingzhou: Chen Baxian did not fight Hou Jing for a city, but took a picked cavalry force by night into Gupu and cut both his rear road and his supply line; once driven back to the Jiankang line, Hou Jing could never again mount a formed counter-offensive.
data: 留下確切數字的地方不算多，但仍有幾條可核。侯景此前已因反齊被追敗一次，退保壽陽議和；太清二年(548)十月再於寒山舉兵，兵只數千，糧不給，這一點在起兵當時就有記載。渡淮之後兵眾迅速膨脹，號稱十餘萬，到臺城城下時已能分出多支專門的攻城隊伍，並有大批舟船運載器械與糧秣。蕭衍兩次遣兵增援，前線一度集結到數萬人，其中蕭綸所部援軍史載為二十萬，敗於寒山之後散歸各鎮。羊侃鎮守臺城自太清三年(549)三月至十一月病故，侯景圍城將近一年才得入城，可見器械與工程在整場戰役中拖住了多少時間。承聖元年(552)陳霸先夜襲渇浦，所部精騎為千餘人，侯景大軍一潰即不可收拾。次年(553)荊州軍進入建康，蕭綱由豫章王蕭棟的廢立中被復立為皇太孫。侯景在位不到兩年(550至552)，死時年五十餘，身死之後其眾隨即崩散，多為荊州軍所收。
dataEn: Few exact figures survive for this war, but several can be checked. Hou Jing had risen against Qi once before and been driven back to Shouyang to make terms; when he raised his revolt again at Hanshan in the tenth month of the second year of Taiqing (548) he had only a few thousand men and no grain, a point already recorded at the time of the rising. After the crossing his host swelled rapidly and was numbered at more than a hundred thousand; by the foot of the palace city he could field several dedicated siege units and had large numbers of boats carrying engines and supplies. Xiao Yan called up reinforcements twice, and the front at one point massed tens of thousands of men, of whom Xiao Lun's relief army is recorded as two hundred thousand; after their defeat at Hanshan they scattered back to their own circuits. Yang Kan held the palace city from the third month of the third year of Taiqing (549) until his death in the eleventh month, and Hou Jing needed close to a year of siege before he could enter — a measure of how much time the engines and the works bought the defenders. In the first year of Chengsheng (552) Chen Baxian struck Gupu by night with a picked cavalry force of a little over a thousand men, and Hou Jing's main army collapsed at the first blow. The following year (553) the Jingzhou army entered Jiankang, and Xiao Gang was restored as crown prince after the deposition of Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Dong. Hou Jing's reign lasted less than two years (550 to 552); he was past fifty when he died, and his following dissolved at once, most of it taken over by the Jingzhou army.
cause: 起兵的根子不在南朝，而在北齊的內部。侯景出身北方寒門，靠在高歡帳下效力取得河南行台的兵權，掌一方重兵卻長期得不到朝廷信任；此前他已不止一次舉兵反齊，曾在寒山一帶起兵而為北齊追兵擊破，退保壽陽議和，兵心與朝廷的信任一齊耗盡。高歡於547年死，高氏兄弟對外姓宿將的防範反而更緊；侯景再與高岳密約，高岳猶豫不決，後又死於部下叛亂，盟約落空，侯景遂孤注一擲。梁朝這邊也沒有留下餘地：侯景以河南行台的名義向梁請糧借兵，梁廷明知其反狀仍予敷衍，只求換取河北安寧，等到發現無法攏絡，才倉促部署江防。魏收、史憲與侯景往還的書信，事後被侯景用為起兵的文告憑據，其實信中所言多勸他據兵自強、等待時機，並非叫他立刻反梁。客觀上，侯景的兩難也逼他鋌而走險：北齊不容他，南朝又拒絕真正的河南之主地位，他手中只剩一支缺糧的偏師與一批必須立刻找到糧食和地盤的部眾。於是548年寒山一點火，四年亂事就此蔓開。
causeEn: The roots of the rising lay not in the south but inside Northern Qi. Hou Jing was a man of humble northern origin who had obtained the military authority of Henan Grand Director through service under Gao Huan; he commanded the troops of a whole province yet was never trusted by the court. He had risen against Qi more than once already, and an earlier revolt had been broken by Qi pursuit parties around Hanshan, leaving him to fall back on Shouyang and sue for peace, so that both his army's nerve and the court's trust in him were spent. Gao Huan died in 547, and the Gao brothers grew only more suspicious of senior generals who were not of their blood; Hou Jing then plotted once more with Gao Yue, but Gao Yue hesitated and later was killed by his own subordinates; the pact came to nothing, and Hou Jing staked everything on a single throw. Liang left no room either: when he asked for grain and troops in the name of Henan Grand Director, the Liang court pretended to oblige while knowing full well he was in revolt, merely wanting stability on its northern frontier, and only scrambled to manage the river defences when it found it could not win him over. The letters that passed between Wei Shou, Shi Xian and Hou Jing were afterwards used by Hou Jing as the documentary basis for his proclamation, though what they actually urged was that he hold his troops and wait for the right moment rather than revolt at once. Objectively, his double bind pushed him into the field: the north would not have him, the south refused him the standing of a real master of Henan, and all that remained in his hands was a hungry detachment and a following that had to find grain and territory at once. One spark at Hanshan in 548, and four years of war spread from there.
impact: 侯景之亂的後果，超出一次邊鎮叛亂的範圍。第一，梁朝原有的軍政結構被打散：禁軍宿將在三年之內或死或降，宿衛建康的部隊幾乎被侯景收編，戰後能成建制重組的只有荊州方面帶回來的兵，以及從亂軍中收撫的降卒，這正是王僧辯、陳霸先得以在數年之內問鼎帝位的資本。第二，侯景以漢為號自立，使這場亂事第一次帶上改朝換代的面目，北齊、西魏與北周各懷觀望，南朝則因此失去了對北方的任何主動權。第三，經過城下的攻城與反攻城，以及士氣崩潰時的潰散，梁朝的裝備體系裡多出大量被侯景軍繳獲、又隨大軍散失的攻城器械，這批鐵料與木料後來成了陳霸先整編軍備的來源之一。第四，554年王僧辯被殺，557年陳霸先代梁建陳，南朝由梁入陳的轉折至此完成。亂事留下的最大教訓，是重兵在邊而禁軍空虛這一條體制病灶，一旦被侯景這樣的人抓住，整個王朝都沒有足夠的縱深來承受。
impactEn: The consequences of Hou Jing's rebellion reached far beyond a frontier mutiny. First, the military and political structure of the Liang court was broken apart: within three years the commanders of the imperial guards were killed or surrendered, the troops that garrisoned Jiankang were almost entirely absorbed into Hou Jing's army, and after the war the only forces that could be reconstituted as units were the men brought back by the Jingzhou army and the surrendered stragglers who were rounded up — the very capital on which Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian were able to bid for the throne within a few years. Second, by proclaiming himself emperor of Han, Hou Jing gave the rebellion for the first time the outward form of a dynastic change; Qi, Western Wei and Northern Zhou all watched from the side, and the south lost whatever initiative it had held in the north. Third, after the siege and the counter-siege and the collapse of morale, the Liang equipment system acquired a large quantity of siege machines captured by Hou Jing's troops and then scattered with the defeated army; that iron and timber later fed Chen Baxian's rearmament. Fourth, Wang Sengbian was killed in 554 and Chen Baxian replaced the Liang with a Chen dynasty in 557, completing the turn from Liang to Chen. The great lesson of the disaster was structural: with the heavy troops on the frontier and the imperial guard hollow, once a man like Hou Jing took hold of that weakness, the dynasty had no depth left to absorb the blow.
result: 結局並不光彩。承聖元年(552)十月陳霸先夜襲渇浦得手，侯景大軍崩潰，退回建康一線，士氣盡失，隨即在同年十一月病歿舟中，諸子與部將分頭奔散，攻城器械與輜重散落城郊，這場橫行四年的亂事在形式上結束。次年荊州軍進入建康，蕭綱在豫章王蕭棟被廢之後復位為皇太孫、旋即帝位，改元承聖，蕭詧以荊州牧的權力成為梁朝實際的執政者，而王僧辯、陳霸先分掌軍權。侯景建立的漢只存在了不到兩年，從未得到任何一州一郡的正式承認，最終連他自己的稱號也隨他的死亡一同消失。梁朝雖復其名，卻已失去淮北與四川的屏障，江北之地拱手於北朝，南朝只剩建康與荊州之間一條窄線，數年後由陳霸先收拾殘局，改朝換代。
resultEn: The ending was not a glorious one. In the tenth month of the first year of Chengsheng (552) Chen Baxian's night attack on Gupu succeeded, Hou Jing's main army broke and fell back to the Jiankang line with its nerve gone, and in the eleventh month of the same year he died of illness in his boat. His sons and commanders fled in different directions, siege machines and baggage lay scattered on the fields outside the city, and the four-year rampage was over in form if not in substance. The following year the Jingzhou army entered Jiankang; Xiao Gang was restored as crown prince after the deposition of Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Dong and then enthroned, changing the era to Chengsheng; Xiao Chen, as Prince of Jingzhou, became the real ruler of the Liang court, while Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian shared the command of the armies. The Han that Hou Jing had proclaimed lasted less than two years and was never acknowledged by any prefecture or commandery; in the end his own title vanished with his death. The Liang recovered its name but had lost both the north of the Huai and Sichuan, and the territory north of the river was handed over to the northern courts, leaving the southern dynasty nothing but the narrow strip between Jiankang and Jingzhou — a situation Chen Baxian would settle a few years later by founding a new dynasty.
